long_biography.plain_text:
Cevdet Caner established Call & Logistik Center while studying business administration. The company developed integrated customer-care operations and listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange in 2001, with Caner serving as management-board chairman. He later shifted toward property investment, advising on sourcing, transactions and financing before becoming chief executive and a minority shareholder of Aggregate Holdings.

His current platform is NIU Invest, which he founded in 2022 and controls. The group combines European real estate with investments in critical minerals. Its recent portfolio has included majority control of Critical Metals, the Minera Tres Valles copper operation in Chile, Botswana's Tati nickel-copper project and financing for Phoenix Copper in Idaho. This places Caner's present work at the intersection of investment, property and mining operations.
